body:
Under the parallel gate (pytest, vitest and Gradle at once on the 12-core host) web tests time
out at vitest's 5 s default now and then: on 2026-11-01, in 5 gate runs, 2 failed this way —
LedgerGuests.test.tsx "offers the unclaimed guests after the members…" and ExpenseListPage.test.tsx
"leaves a share the user typed alone…" (5.5 s, 5.1 s), then LedgerGuests "sends the typed
names…" (5.3 s), RedeemPage(?) "redeems the token of an invite link pasted inside a whole
message" (5.2 s) and a follow-on failure in the same file. Each passes on its own and on the
rerun. T-372 fixed one such test by replacing userEvent with fireEvent; the pattern is the
gate's load, not the tests. Decide: raise vitest's testTimeout for the gate (e.g. 15 s via an
environment variable the gate sets), give vitest fewer workers under the gate, or make the slow
tests cheaper. The flaky-by-load tests must not be masked by retries.
title: web: tests time out under the parallel gate's load (vitest 5 s)
